name: Face-tracking avatar
summary: A camera tracks the face of a person and moves a drawn or 3D character at the same time, so the character acts as a live host.
how: Track blinks, mouth shape and head tilt at 30 fps or more.
Map each value to a layer of the avatar rig.
Draw the character with flat colour and a clear outline.

origin.note: Kizuna AI uses a tracked 3D avatar as the host of a YouTube channel, and other makers follow the same rig.

adoptions.via: Virtual YouTubers use tracked anime-style avatars as live hosts.
